A '''diamond pickaxe''' is the [[Diamond equipment|diamond]] [[Tools#Pickaxe|pickaxe]], crafted from [[Diamond|diamonds]]. It mines at speed 9 and has 2500 durability.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/diamond_pickaxe.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

The vanilla recipe is blocked and replaced by the pack's own, which sets the stats shown in the infobox.

=== Chest loot ===
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

=== Mining ===

It mines pickaxe blocks at speed 9 (vanilla: 8).

It mines obsidian, crying obsidian and ender chests at speed 35, far faster than other blocks.

=== Combat ===

It deals 5 damage with an attack speed of 1.2.

=== Repairing ===

It is repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[Diamond|diamonds]]. The pack keeps the repair cost at zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely (see [[Repairing]]).

=== Smelting ingredient ===
In a [[Blast Furnace|blast furnace]], it smelts into one [[Diamond|diamond]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blast/diamond_from_blasting_diamond_materials.json}}</ref>

== Notes ==
* Diamond ore itself drops [[Raw Diamond|raw diamonds]], which need a [[Blast Furnace|blast furnace]] before they can be used in this recipe.
